title: Tight Bounds for RHtE KDM Authenticated Encryption
summary: RHtE's proven random-nonce KDM authenticated-encryption bound appears loose; tighten it or design an alternative scheme with a provably tight bound.

formal_statement.body: For the RHtE construction, the existing proof of random-nonce KDM authenticated-encryption security (with key-independent headers) yields a concrete bound that appears not to be tight. Obtain a proof with a better bound for RHtE in this setting, or design an alternative KDM-secure authenticated-encryption scheme for which a tight bound can be proved.

scope.domain: Concrete security analysis of RHtE and KDM-secure authenticated encryption.
parameters: Concrete security bound — the quantity to improve or prove tight
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove a better bound for RHtE in this setting, or design an alternative KDM-secure authenticated-encryption scheme with a provably tight bound.

citations.label: Authenticated and Misuse-Resistant Encryption of Key-Dependent Data

progress.summary: The source presents the concrete security bound proved for RHtE as weaker than desired and explicitly asks for either a better bound or an alternative scheme with such a bound.
citation_labels: Mihir Bellare et al., Authenticated and Misuse-Resistant Encryption of Key-Dependent Data
